headline: C.Y.T. Ohio Factory Faces Ransomware Attack, Keeps Delays Minimal
body: Cardington Yutaka Technologies in Ohio experienced a ransomware incident targeting their admin and scheduling networks, leading to nominal workflow disruptions. Production processes have remained stable through alternative manual methods. The impact is limited to minor delays in shipments, for which downstream clients have been proactively notified. Company officials are prioritizing a swift resolution to resume full digital operations.
